guards.what: N1: `_turnsSeen` is NEVER reset at a combat boundary on EITHER side -- the counter deliberately carries across combats
guards.rationale: PROMPT.md bug class 13 demands the trace before clearing a missing reset, and here the reset is missing from C# too, on purpose: TurnsSeen is a [SavedProperty] (FakeHappyFlower.cs:64-65) so it survives a save/load, and the file's only other override, AfterCombatEnd (lines 101-105), touches Status and not the counter. The sim's relic instance lives on RunState.relics and is re-attached to each CombatState, which is exactly the persistence this needs. EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b05.py flower-blood): a relic instance leaving combat 1 with turns_seen = 4 enters combat 2, ticks to 0 on that combat's first turn and grants the energy immediately -- the run-level 'every 5th turn you take' behaviour, matching C#. This relic sits in .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md sweep A's 'never reset at a combat boundary' bucket and is CLEARED here, unlike relic/belt_buckle where the same shape is a live gap. The sim's sts2_rl/relics/base.py:20-24 docstring claim that 'Happy Flower's carry-over turn counter' is 'per-combat / constructor-injected' is WRONG for the fake (there is no constructor argument at all, fake_happy_flower.py:23-25) and the port is correct in spite of it -- PROMPT.md bug class 11's warning about docstrings applies to the sim's own comments as evidence. [CITATION CORRECTED 2026-07-26 by the relic fix pass: the path was written as a bare basename plus line range (`base` `.py:20-24`), which audit/tools/backfill_sources.py cannot resolve -- four files in the repo are called base.py -- so the citation was discarded and the file left unpinned. It means sts2_rl/relics/base.py:20-24, the module docstring's 'per-run counters (Girya lifts, Happy Flower's carry-over turn counter) are per-combat / constructor-injected' paragraph.]
